scenario: An AI agent given a navigation task requests precise geolocation data for a purpose the user did not consent to (for example marketing or ad targeting), after its task drifts through a prompt injection, a tool misuse or an over-broad instruction.

inherent.rationale: Location data is available to several services and attractive for secondary use. Impact is severe for regulatory exposure and user harm.

control.name: Purpose limitation gate on every agent tool call that reads precise geolocation

tolerance: Medium or below without owner sign-off
